1. A history book with a purpose, not pure history
 - Chronicles covers history from Adam all the way to the decree of Cyrus.
 - The books of Kings follow on naturally from Josh, Judg, Ruth, 1 & 2 Sam, recording history as it continues, but Chronicles goes back to the very beginning, all the way to Adam.

This means the author of Chronicles, looking back on history, dug all the way down to the roots. So Chronicles was written with a clear purpose.
- They came back after 70 years in the Babylonian Exile, and the country was a mess.
The situation is that they're trying to make a fresh start in a place that has completely collapsed, like a wasteland.
